editorial: This report contains trends that have emerged for the first time today, without repeating records included in normal reports from the last 30 days.

items.title: openai/skills
items.summary: Skills, developed by OpenAI, offers a library of predefined functional capabilities (skills) for the code-writing model Codex. This resource creates a standard structure that allows developers to enable AI models to perform specific tasks.

items.title: llvm/llvm-project
items.summary: The LLVM Project is an infrastructure that provides modular and reusable compiler and toolchain technologies. It enables code optimization and adaptation to different hardware architectures in software development processes.

items.title: coreyhaines31/marketingskills
items.summary: MarketingSkills is a JavaScript library developed for AI agents to perform marketing tasks. It provides specialized capabilities to AI models in areas such as conversion rate optimization (CRO), copywriting, search engine optimization (SEO), and data analytics.

items.title: aipoch/open-science
items.summary: Open Science, developed by AIPOCH, offers a local-first and model-agnostic AI workspace for scientific research. The software combines Python and R notebooks with data connections, allowing scientific processes to be conducted in a reproducible manner.

items.title: OpenWhispr/openwhispr
items.summary: OpenWhispr is a voice-to-text dictation application that combines local models with cloud-based options. With its privacy-focused structure, it allows you to run models like Nvidia Parakeet or Whisper on your own device or use cloud services with your own API key.

items.title: The-Swarm-Corporation/AutoHedge
items.summary: AutoHedge is a framework that uses swarm intelligence and AI agents to automate market analysis, risk management, and trading operations. It allows users to create their own autonomous hedge funds in minutes.

items.title: Stremio/stremio-web
items.summary: Stremio is a media player application that combines different content providers into a single interface. This web-based version allows users to watch series and movies through the browser without any installation.

items.title: Nitter and XCancel resume service after legal advice
items.summary: Nitter and XCancel, which allow viewing the X platform without its interface, have resumed service following legal consultation processes. These tools allow users to access content on the social media platform X (formerly Twitter) without logging in.

items.title: Asahi Linux on M3
items.summary: Asahi Linux support for Apple's M3-powered devices is now officially available. This development represents a critical milestone for running the open-source operating system Linux on hardware with Apple Silicon architecture.

items.title: An Alien Mind
items.summary: OpenAI has published research examining how large language models have a different way of reasoning compared to the human mind. This study analyzes the cognitive differences in the problem-solving processes of AI systems and their functioning, which resembles an alien mind structure.

items.title: Keep Our Servers Running
items.summary: The Internet Archive has launched a campaign to triple donations made throughout September to ensure the continuity of digital resources. This non-profit digital library expects regular support from its users to cover server costs.

items.title: GrapheneOS Overhauled Default Apps and Secure Clipboard
items.summary: The privacy-focused mobile operating system GrapheneOS has updated its default app management and secure clipboard features. These improvements, which allow users to more strictly control data sharing, aim to prevent data leaks across the system.

items.title: The Attention Triangle in Audio-Video Models
items.summary: Audio-video diffusion models use a cross-modal attention mechanism to match text, audio, and visual content. This study examines the attention triangle between text, audio, and video streams to investigate how semantic information is transferred between modalities during the generation process and to analyze systemic data leakage.

items.title: To See a World in a Living Context: Unified Indoor-Outdoor Urban World Generation
items.summary: HoloWorld offers a production framework that combines indoor and outdoor spaces in a single urban context using text-based 3D modeling. It aims to create cross-scale consistent and continuously updated urban environments based on user descriptions.

items.title: τ^τ-Bench: An Environment for End-To-End, Realistic Agent Construction
items.summary: τ^τ-Bench is an evaluation platform that measures the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in creating software agents under real-world conditions. This system tests the ability of developer agents to build end-to-end software that meets complex business requirements through standardized scenarios.

items.title: Enoki: Efficient Multi-Level Hallucination Detection
items.summary: Enoki is a multi-level fact-checking framework developed to detect misinformation generated by large language models. By performing analysis at both the claim and text span levels, it makes complex verification processes more efficient and consistent.

items.title: ShallowStream: Index Shallow then Answer Deep for Streaming Video Understanding
items.summary: ShallowStream is a method that reduces the processing load of multimodal large language models that analyze continuous video streams. It makes real-time video tracking more efficient by first indexing visual data superficially and then processing the required parts in depth.

items.title: It took a year to ship WebAssembly in Anubis
items.summary: The Anubis programming language has released WebAssembly support after a one-year development process. This integration increases the language's portability across different platforms and provides runtime support for browser-based applications.

items.title: Python Iceberg
items.summary: Python Iceberg is a knowledge resource where lesser-known and complex features of the Python language are examined in depth. It provides technical details for developers who want to understand the fundamental workings and hidden mechanisms (internals) of the language.

glossary.explanation: Small software plugins that enable smart devices to understand and execute specific commands.
Software that translates code written by humans into machine language that a computer can directly understand and execute.
Intelligent software units that can make decisions on their own, use tools to reach goals, and complete tasks.
Improvements made to ensure a larger portion of people visiting a website make a purchase or sign up.
Persuasive texts written to convince people to buy a product or perform an action.
Arrangement and improvement efforts made for websites to appear higher in search engine rankings.
A software approach that relies on data being stored directly on your device without needing the internet and being able to work while offline.
Technology that listens to your spoken words in real-time and converts them into written text.
Artificial intelligence models trained on massive amounts of data that can understand human language and generate text.
A collective working method where many small and simple units come together to solve complex problems.
